name: SelfMem

paper.title: SelfMem: Self-Optimizing Memory for AI Agents

construction.unit: agent-written workspace items over an immutable raw transcript
construction.processing: agent reads transcript via SQL, writes, reviews and revises memory operations

organization.structure: free-form workspace; structure chosen by the agent
organization.stores: read-only SQLite turns table + memory workspace
organization.index: SQLite turns table queried by read-only SQL

management.operations: add, replace, merge, archive, delete, pin, reorganize (Table 2)
management.conflicts: review tools flag contradictions/stale facts; agent revises
management.forgetting: agent archives stale items or deletes via write tools

retrieval.candidates: relevant transcript turns/snippets; zero embedding requests reported
retrieval.selection: fixed answer-time retrieval guided by the workspace (App. B)

use.context: workspace JSON + last five Q/A + top retrieved chunks
use.reasoning: single answer call; retrieved evidence overrides memory

classify.note: Agent adds, merges, archives and reorganises its workspace; answer-time retrieval is fixed (App. B).

stages.ingestion: The raw transcript is stored unchanged as a read-only SQLite 'turns' table (turn index, role, time anchor, content).
stages.construction: An LLM agent runs an inspect-write-review-revise tool loop: it reads the transcript via manifest / read-only SQL / entity search, and writes auditable memory operations (add, replace, merge, archive, exact facts, timelines, retrieval hints) into a free-form workspace.
stages.organization: A free-form memory workspace whose structure (profile, preference list, timeline, project state, policy notes) is chosen by the agent.
stages.update: Memory-review tools flag missing source support, stale facts, contradictions and over-broad summaries; the agent revises the workspace accordingly.
stages.retrieval: At query time relevant transcript turns/snippets are retrieved using the workspace as a guide (targeted RAG / SQL / semantic search chosen by the model); no embedding requests in the reported runs.
stages.answer: The answer model receives the query, the final workspace and retrieved transcript evidence; the prompt treats retrieved evidence as authoritative over memory.
stages.learning: Optional iterative strategy refinement: the model rewrites its own memory-strategy notes from aggregate training-conversation scores and tool diagnostics (no weight updates).

summary: Keeps the raw transcript immutable and lets an LLM agent decide, via memory tools and feedback diagnostics, what to write, revise and later retrieve, optionally refining its own memory strategy from aggregate feedback.
notes:
Authors: Shu Yang, Junchao Wu, Derek F. Wong, Di Wang (KAUST PRADA Lab; University of Macau). An OpenReview forum entry exists (id fXHmKW9H8r) but no acceptance venue was confirmed. No code URL found. Only benchmark is BEAM (100K/500K/1M); no LoCoMo/LongMemEval results. AXES-CHECK: seed taxonomy row consistent with the paper.
DESIGN: Sec 3.3-3.7, 4.1, App. A Table 2, App. B, App. C Prompts 2-3. Table 2 describes SelfMem as conditionally retrieving, but App. B says answer-time retrieval is fixed; control.retrieval follows App. B. Optional strategy refinement from aggregate feedback (Sec 5) revises the construction policy. query/budget null: not specified.
